question: The analysis of the data obtained from cases of Ebola virus disease in Guinea and Sierra Leone, allows us to affirm that:

options.opa: The mortality of the infection exceeds 85%.
options.opb: The treatment is based on support measures (hydroelectrolitic replenishment i.v. and antibiotics).
options.opc: More than half of the cases correspond to health personnel.
options.opd: Gastrointestinal hemorrhage is a common cause of mortality.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Ebola virus infection -> high mortality rate -> exceeds 85% -> 95% confident CHAIN: Treatment for Ebola -> support measures -> hydroelectrolytic replenishment i.v. and antibiotics -> 90% confident CHAIN: Cases of Ebola -> more than half health personnel -> 60% confident CHAIN: Gastrointestinal hemorrhage in Ebola cases -> common cause of mortality -> 80% confident CHAIN: Mortality in Ebola cases -> higher in adolescents -> 85%
analysis: The mortality of Ebola virus disease in Guinea and Sierra Leone is high, but it does not exceed 85%. Treatment primarily involves supportive measures like hydroelectrolytic replenishment and symptomatic management. Health personnel are at increased risk of infection due to their exposure. Gastrointestinal hemorrhage can occur but is not the most common cause of mortality. Mortality rates can vary across different age groups.
